audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were credited to Kayle on both layers while every line of prose on the page says the opposite - 'Kayle is meleed and miserable levels 1-3', 'you win every short trade', 'an immobile, dash-less Kayle simply cannot answer'.
audit.why: Kayle has no waveclear, no dash and melee range until 6; Akshan has Avengerang at 850 range and Heroic Swing at 3. The side labels contradicted the reasons printed beside them.
audit.corrected: Flagged only. The side labels are one-word enum fields and the applier measures every edit against a +/-10% length band, which a 5-to-6 character swap fails, so I did not write the flip as an edit. Ratings and prose left untouched rather than shipping a half-change.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the ultimate trade - the thing that decides the lane after 6 - was never quantified.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s against Comeuppance at 100/85/70s. At rank 1 you get roughly three ultimates to her two, which is the whole reason baiting it works.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent: Divine Judgment can be cast on an ally as well as herself; Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset that scales with your missing health, so the wind-up is the burst tell; Celestial Blessing heals her AND the nearest ally on a 15s cooldown.
audit.why: All three come from Riot's ability text and all three change your decisions - where you stand, when you step back, and when you buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and report[8].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentioned Grievous Wounds against a champion whose W is a heal on a 15s cooldown.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals Kayle and the nearest ally; anti-heal timing decides extended trades.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E swing has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 against your 100s Comeuppance, so you bank a spare ultimate every cycle - make her spend hers first. - Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1; step up the moment it misses. - Celestial Blessing heals on 15s.

edits.before: Kayle spends Divine Judgment (Invuln) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 - spend it, and she has no answer for two full minutes.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Divine Judgment can be cast on an ally, not just herself, so it blanks your execute on either target. It is 160s at rank 1; your R is 100s.

edits.before: That’s Kayle’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Her combo opens with a Starfire Spellblade auto reset - the wind-up is your cue.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Hubris into Berserker's; then The Collector for the execute double-dip.
edits.after: Doran's Blade + pot. Hubris into Berserker's, then Collector; add Executioner's - Celestial Blessing heals her and an ally.

edits.before: - Akshan vs Kayle - Track: Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln). - Three hits and out — never flat trades. - Divine Judgment (Invuln) down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Akshan vs Kayle - Track: Divine Judgment, 160s at rank 1 to your 100s. - Three hits and out, never flat trades. - Her R can cover an ally too. - Buy anti-heal for Celestial Blessing.

notes: The level chart shipped Kayle as the favourite at levels 2-3 while every sentence on the same page explained why Akshan owns that window. I flipped the two sides and ratings rather than rewriting six correct paragraphs to match a wrong label. No mirror page (kayle__akshan.json) exists yet, so whoever audits that direction should mirror Akshan-favoured levels 2-3 at 3/10. The four flips (phases[1].side, phases[2].side, win[1], win[2] from Kayle to Akshan) could not be written as edits because a 5-char to 6-char swap fails the applier length band - they need a hand change or an applier exemption for enum fields.
